Prefecture|Okayama]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[Joseon [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.{{cite web {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national Prefecture|Okayama]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{short description|None}}
{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Okayama)]] {{short description|None}}
{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Prefecture]] of [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including one *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Site]]); the [[:en:Joseon Tongsinsa|Joseon Mission Sites]] includes sites in [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] and [[:en:Shizuoka Prefecture|Shizuoka]] Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]] |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

{{GeoGroup}} This list is of the [[Monuments of Japan|Historic Sites of Japan]] located within the {{ill|Prefectures of Japan|en|Prefectures of Japan|WD=Q50337|lt=Prefecture}} of {{ill|Okayama Prefecture|en|Okayama Prefecture|WD=Q132936|lt=Okayama}}.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
==National Historic Sites== As of 6 August 2019, forty-seven Sites have been {{ill|Cultural Property (Japan)|en|Cultural Property (Japan)|WD=Q858308|lt=designated}} as being of national {{ill|Values (heritage)|en|Values (heritage)|WD=Q7912786|lt=significance}} (including one *{{ill|List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|en|List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|WD=Q20982902|lt=Special Historic Site}}); the {{ill|Joseon Tongsinsa|en|Joseon Tongsinsa|WD=Q482690|lt=Joseon Mission Sites}} includes sites in {{ill|Hiroshima Prefecture|en|Hiroshima Prefecture|WD=Q617375|lt=Hiroshima}} and {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|en|Shizuoka Prefecture|WD=Q131320|lt=Shizuoka}} Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher={{ill|Okayama Prefecture|en|Okayama Prefecture|WD=Q132936|lt=Okayama Prefecture}} |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>

the {{ill|Joseon Tongsinsa|en|Joseon Tongsinsa|WD=Q482690|lt=Joseon Mission Sites|1=Joseon Tongsinsa}} includes sites in {{ill|Hiroshima Prefecture|en|Hiroshima Prefecture|WD=Q617375|lt=Hiroshima|1=Hiroshima Prefecture}} and {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|en|Shizuoka Prefecture|WD=Q131320|lt=Shizuoka|1=Shizuoka Prefecture}} Prefectures.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 July 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 岡山県 ２県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |accessdate=8 August 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170502003537/http://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index_pc.html |archive-date=2 May 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Okayama">{{cite web |url=http://www.pref.okayama.jp/page/550677.html |script-title=ja:岡山県内指定文化財等件数一覧 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in Okayama Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher={{ill|Okayama Prefecture|en|Okayama Prefecture|WD=Q132936|lt=Okayama Prefecture|1=Okayama Prefecture}} |date=6 August 2019 |accessdate=8 August 2019}}</ref>
